subject: Request: non-standard GPU compatibility waiver & temporary reservation hold for Veldynamics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Evers <tom@veldynamics.ai>, Anika Rao <anika@veldynamics.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Veldynamics: ask for GPU-family swap + transient reservation hold (Committed Dedicated)

Team — looping you in on an urgent request from Veldynamics (deal VELD-1492). TL;DR: they want to switch their 12mo Dedicated reservation from A100-family to H100-family due to unexpected inference quality & latency regressions on A100 with their new model; they also want a short reservation hold window (4–6 weeks) while they migrate. They are asking for: 1) SKU compatibility waiver to allow an H100 substitution on their existing commitment term; 2) a transient reservation hold during migration so they don't have to consume the existing reservation while migration is in-flight; 3) a one-time commercial concession (they've asked for 20% credit on the first 3 months).

Numbers/context from the customer: current committed monthly spend: $156k; projected uplift for H100 pool: ~+18% unit cost; migration window requested: Nov 23–Dec 31 (approx 6 weeks). Customer says performance uplift on H100 reduces per-inference latency by ~30% and halves tail latency. They've attached the perf comparison.

Asks:
- Infrastructure (Aditya): guidance on safety/compatibility and operational risk for swapping reserved SKU family mid-term; feasibility of reservation hold and how we would account for usage and billing for the hold window.
- RevOps (Marissa): revenue recognition and ARR impact if we approve a hold + credit; what we can safely offer without breaking comps.
- Legal (Laura): any contract language or SOW amendment required for a non-standard SKU substitution and a temporary reservation hold.

Customer contact: Tom Evers (CTO) and Anika Rao (Head of Ops). They are flagged as a near-term close (executive sponsor engaged). I recommend we treat this as time-sensitive — they said they'd pause signature until we confirm we can support the H100 path.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Evers <tom@veldynamics.ai>, Anika Rao <anika@veldynamics.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veldynamics: ask for GPU-family swap + transient reservation hold (Committed Dedicated)

Karthik / team — reviewed the perf CSV they sent. Summary from infra side: H100 swap is technically feasible but not a drop-in in every cluster. Key operational points: 1) model KV cache and attention kernel characteristics differ; some models will need slight re-tuning for memory placement causing a short stabilization period; 2) if we place them into an H100-only pool we can avoid interference, but this requires a one-time migration plan and a brief cooldown where we recommend reduced traffic; 3) reservation hold: we can implement a billing hold where the committed reservation is paused, but we need a clear policy on how to account for burst consumption during the hold (we can gate burst to prevent uncontrolled overage).

Constraints & recommended guardrails:
- We cannot retroactively change the SKU on a committed reservation without an executive exception; operationally we'll provision a dedicated H100 tenant matched to their reservation throughput, but this will increase unit costs ~18–22% depending on region.
- For the hold window (4–6 weeks), recommend a max-burst cap of 300% of baseline with an overage rate capped at the current A100 list overage * 1.1 (instead of the customer's requested flat low cap). This reduces revenue erosion.
- Performance/regression risk: we should run a quick smoke migration in a dedicated staging H100 node (2–3 days) before cutover — I can schedule infra resources if approved.

Attached: perf comparison and a short infra migration checklist.

Aditya
Head of Infra & Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Evers <tom@veldynamics.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veldynamics: ask for GPU-family swap + transient reservation hold (Committed Dedicated)

Thanks — quick finance/ops take from my side: approving a full reservation hold plus a 20% commercial credit is material. If we do the hold we need a clear amendment path for ARR recognition and a finance-approved credit memo. Options that are acceptable to RevOps/Finance without exec overstep:

1) Approve reservation hold for up to 6 weeks, require customer to sign a one-off amendment that documents start/end dates and confirms they accept the H100 unit cost uplift for the remainder of the term. No upfront credit beyond a single month credit cap (we can offer 1 month free or a fixed $X credit) — this protects ARR.

2) If Sales wants to give a multi-month percentage credit, we need Deal Desk + VP Sales sign-off. 20% on first 3 months is > our normal concession bands for this tier.

On the overage rate: I agree with Aditya that capping overage to A100_list *1.1 is reasonable. For bursting during the hold we should gate via quota so we don't create open exposure.

If Sales needs a quick yes to keep the signature moving, I can greenlight option (1) immediately; option (2) requires formal exec approval and a brief write-up of revenue impact.

Marissa
Senior Manager, RevOps
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tom Evers <tom@veldynamics.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veldynamics: ask for GPU-family swap + transient reservation hold (Committed Dedicated)

Quick legal note: any amendment needs three items at minimum: 1) explicit description of the SKU swap (A100 -> H100) and how utilization is measured post-swap; 2) terms for the reservation hold window including start/end dates and confirmation that reserved capacity will not be consumed elsewhere; 3) clear billing rules for burst/overage during the hold (caps and rates). Please don't commit to a credit amount until Finance signs off and we prepare the amendment. I drafted language for an amendment — see attached docx (proposed_amendment_draft.docx).

We also need a mutual acceptance of the migration smoke plan to avoid disputes on SLA deviations during the transition period.

Laura
Senior Counsel
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Veldynamics: ask for GPU-family swap + transient reservation hold (Committed Dedicated)

Team — following the internal thread and customer's urgency, Tom asked for an executive decision so they can move to signature this week. Summary of what the customer needs now: H100 substitution on their committed term, a 6-week reservation hold (Nov 23–Dec 31), capped burst during hold, and a commercial concession that helps offset migration costs.

Marissa — can you confirm which option you approve for me to offer on behalf of Revenue Ops? If you can do option (1) (reservation hold + 1 month credit / fixed $40k credit) I will present that to the customer as the immediate path forward and will ask them to sign the amendment + smoke test CDA. If Exec signoff is required for a larger concession (Sales/AE asks for 20% × 3 months), I'll pause and escalate to VP Sales.

Tom / Anika — apologies for the back-and-forth; we've got a path here. If you can confirm acceptance of an amendment that documents the hold dates and agrees to the H100 unit cost for the remainder of the term, we can schedule the smoke migration next week.

Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
